name: Beef "Sheet Pan Kebab" Plate with Yellow Rice, Cucumber Salad & Mint Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ red bell pepper
1 lemon
1 English cucumber
½ small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and roughly chop bell pepper. Place in a food processor.
Peel, halve, and roughly chop onion; peel garlic. Add both to the food processor. Blend on high until veggies are finely chopped, scraping down the sides of the processor as needed, 20-30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium white onion
2 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add beef and spices to the food processor. Blend on high, scraping down the sides of the processor as needed, until meat is smooth and paste-like, about 60 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb lean ground beef
2 tsp paprika
1 tsp fennel seeds
1 tsp cumin, ground
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp coriander, ground

instructions.primary_message: Coat a baking sheet pan with oil. Transfer beef mixture to the baking sheet, then use damp hands to spread it out into a 3/4-inch thick rectangle (you don't need to push it all the way to the edges of the baking sheet). Using the tip of a butter knife, cut 7 lines in the meat, about 1 inch apart, to yield 8 "kebabs" (make sure to cut all the way through the meat).
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until the kebabs are cooked through, 15-20 minutes (the meat will shrink slightly as it cooks).

Meanwhile, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and turmeric, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup basmati rice
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth
½ tsp turmeric, ground

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, juice lemon. Divide between two small bowls, then set one bowl aside for the mint yogurt.
Add oil, salt, and pepper to the remaining small bowl with the lemon juice, then stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice cucumber. Add to the bowl with the dressing, stir to coat, and set aside.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the reserved bowl with the lemon juice along with yogurt, sugar, and spices, then stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ¼ cups plain Greek yogurt
½ tsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp cumin, ground

instructions.primary_message: When the kebabs are done, remove from the oven. Let cool slightly, 5 minutes.
To serve, divide rice, kebabs, cucumber salad, and mint yogurt between plates. Enjoy!
